sources.quote: a change of coating or surface treatment
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: BR-180 belongs to PRG-Z (Aurelia). Moving from clear anodising to the Nanoceram finish is a coating change. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual replaces revision 3, which only required notification for a change within the same specification family. Revision 4 requires written Aurelia approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipment, plus 90 days' notice. Nothing in force covers this change: the deviations listed do not apply to BR-180 coating.

sources.quote: do not contain lead, mercury, cadmium or hexavalent chromium

findings.why: Nanoceram is not in the coating catalogue, so its substances are unknown. Without that information we cannot check it against the ELV ban on Pb, Hg, Cd and Cr(VI). Process engineering (P. Romano) should obtain the substance declaration, and should also confirm which coater is offering it, since the proposal names none.
